UPDATE SURVEY_USER
USER_NAME = #{userName},
JUMIN_NUM = #{juminNum},
USER_PHONE = #{userPhone},
USER_EMAIL = #{userEmail},
ADDRESS = #{address}, ADDRESS2 = #{address2},
UPT_ID = #{uptId}, UPT_DATE = NOW(), SUBMISSION_DATE = NOW()
WHERE EVENT_SEQ = #{eventSeq} AND BINARY USER_KEY = #{userKey}
mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN MAP.GENERAL_AUTH_CODE IS NULL THEN 'NOT_FOUND' WHEN U.SUBMISSION_DATE IS NOT NULL THEN 'ALREADY_ANSWERED' WHEN U.SUBMISSION_DATE IS NULL AND U.SURVEY_AUTH_TIME IS NOT NULL AND U.SURVEY_AUTH_TIME >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) THEN 'TIME_RESTRICTED' WHEN U.SUBMISSION_DATE IS NULL AND (U.SURVEY_AUTH_TIME IS NULL OR U.SURVEY_AUTH_TIME < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MINUTE)) THEN 'VALID' ELSE 'NOT_FOUND' END as authStatus, M.EVENT_SEQ as eventSeq, M.EVENT_CODE as eventCode, M.EVENT_TYPE as eventType, MAP.GENERAL_AUTH_CODE as generalAuthCode, MAP.USER_KEY as userKey, U.SUBMISSION_DATE as submissionDate, U.SURVEY_AUTH_TIME as surveyAuthTime, NOW() as currentTime FROM SURVEY_MASTER M INNER JOIN AUTH_USER_MAPPING MAP ON M.EVENT_SEQ = MAP.EVENT_SEQ AND MAP.GENERAL_AUTH_CODE = #{generalAuthCode} LEFT JOIN SURVEY_USER U ON (MAP.EVENT_SEQ = U.EVENT_SEQ AND MAP.USER_KEY = U.USER_KEY) WHERE M.AUTH_CODE_URL = #{authCodeUrl} LIMIT 1

SELECT CASE WHEN MAP.GENERAL_AUTH_CODE IS NULL THEN 'NOT_FOUND' WHEN U.SUBMISSION_DATE IS NOT NULL THEN 'ALREADY_ANSWERED' WHEN U.SUBMISSION_DATE IS NULL AND U.SURVEY_AUTH_TIME IS NOT NULL AND U.SURVEY_AUTH_TIME >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) THEN 'TIME_RESTRICTED' WHEN U.SUBMISSION_DATE IS NULL AND (U.SURVEY_AUTH_TIME IS NULL OR U.SURVEY_AUTH_TIME < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MINUTE)) THEN 'VALID' ELSE 'NOT_FOUND' END as authStatus, M.EVENT_SEQ as eventSeq, M.EVENT_CODE as eventCode, M.EVENT_TYPE as eventType, MAP.GENERAL_AUTH_CODE as generalAuthCode, MAP.USER_KEY as userKey, U.SUBMISSION_DATE as submissionDate, U.SURVEY_AUTH_TIME as surveyAuthTime, NOW() as currentTime FROM SURVEY_MASTER M INNER JOIN AUTH_USER_MAPPING MAP ON M.EVENT_SEQ = MAP.EVENT_SEQ AND MAP.GENERAL_AUTH_CODE = #{generalAuthCode} LEFT JOIN SURVEY_USER U ON (MAP.EVENT_SEQ = U.EVENT_SEQ AND MAP.USER_KEY = U.USER_KEY) WHERE M.EVENT_CODE = #{eventCode} LIMIT 1

SELECT U.SEQ as seq, U.EVENT_SEQ as eventSeq, U.USER_KEY as userKey, M.EVENT_CODE as eventCode, M.EVENT_TYPE as eventType, M.AUTH as auth, MAP.GENERAL_AUTH_CODE as generalAuthCode FROM SURVEY_MASTER M INNER JOIN AUTH_USER_MAPPING MAP ON M.EVENT_SEQ = MAP.EVENT_SEQ LEFT JOIN SURVEY_USER U ON MAP.USER_KEY = U.USER_KEY AND MAP.EVENT_SEQ = U.EVENT_SEQ WHERE MAP.GENERAL_AUTH_CODE = #{generalAuthCode} AND M.AUTH_CODE_URL = #{authCodeUrl} AND (U.SUBMISSION_DATE IS NULL) ORDER BY MAP.REG_DATE ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT U.SEQ as seq, U.EVENT_SEQ as eventSeq, U.USER_KEY as userKey, M.EVENT_CODE as eventCode, M.EVENT_TYPE as eventType, M.AUTH as auth, MAP.GENERAL_AUTH_CODE as generalAuthCode FROM SURVEY_MASTER M INNER JOIN AUTH_USER_MAPPING MAP ON M.EVENT_SEQ = MAP.EVENT_SEQ LEFT JOIN SURVEY_USER U ON MAP.USER_KEY = U.USER_KEY AND MAP.EVENT_SEQ = U.EVENT_SEQ WHERE MAP.GENERAL_AUTH_CODE = #{generalAuthCode} AND M.EVENT_CODE = #{eventCode} AND (U.SUBMISSION_DATE IS NULL) ORDER BY MAP.REG_DATE ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT , M.EVENT_CODE as eventCode, M.EVENT_TYPE as eventType, M.EVENT_NAME as eventName, M.AUTH as auth FROM SURVEY_USER U INNER JOIN SURVEY_MASTER M ON U.EVENT_SEQ = M.EVENT_SEQ WHERE M.EVENT_CODE = #{eventCode} AND U.RESEND_USER_PHONE = #{resendUserPhone} AND U.DEL_YN = 'N' LIMIT 1
